QuestInfo.name: [Azwan] The False Elixir 3
QuestInfo.0: You obtain the elixir circulating in the Ariant's markets. Talk to #bGardin#k at the #bAzwan Obelisk#k.
QuestInfo.1: Gardin says the shamaness of Azwan will know what the elixir is. Take it to #bMedina#k in the #bAzwan Refugee Zone#k.
QuestInfo.2: The elixir circulating in Ariant was a magic concoction made by Hilla that causes obsession and madness.

0.0: I know, go show it to that shamaness of Azwan you met. #bMedina#k, was it? She'd know if it is the real deal or not.

yes.0: I'd do it myself if I could, but when I went in, I couldn't see any ghosts. I should go ask for some magic that will help with that, but in the meantime, you'll have to handle it.

no.0: How else are you going to learn more about it on short notice?

1.0: Hm? Not to be rude, as I said there is no Elix--what? You say this bottle contains the elixir? Strange, let me read the what is inscribed here...
1.1: 'The loss of beauty across this fair world so saddens me. I have in my possession the #rpower of immortality#k, which I shall grant to only the most beautiful souls.'                                                              \r\n- Hilla -\r\n
1.2: Could Hilla have truly obtained that power after offering Azwan to the Black Mage? Is such a thing even possible...?
1.3: Wait. When I focus, I can sense something from within the elixir... it's #rHilla's magic#k!

yes.0: ...There is a powerful and terrible curse in this elixir. It will draw out the #robession and madness#k hidden in people's hearts. I have no doubt this is Hilla's handiwork.

npc.0: The shamaness of Azwan would know if this is really from Azwan or not. Please have #bMedina#k check it out.

item.0: Do you need something? Advice for the #bAlliance#k perhaps?

lost.0: You dropped this #belixir#k. Fortunately, the bottle didn't break. Please be more careful next time.
